'''Marc Casal''' (born August 13, 1987, in [[Canillo]], [[Andorra]]) is an [[Andorra]]n [[figure skater]]. He is the 2004 Andorran national champion and three time junior national champion. Along with [[Melissandre Fuentes]], he was the first skater to represent Andorra in an ISU Championship, which they both achieved at the [[2002 World Junior Figure Skating Championships]].
